title: Let core completion recovery distinguish unconfirmed root and fingerprint requirements
outcome: Let core completion recovery distinguish unconfirmed root and fingerprint requirements
acceptance: A test records a named-root evaluation declaring a new revision before its report: done returns a structured unconfirmed-declaration cause with end-turn/read-and-retry guidance, then a matching host sighting makes completion eligible without another judgment

Tests for missing completion measurement, measured mismatch and absent evaluation source basis retain their different safe remedies; source mismatch or absent basis never advises copying an earlier fingerprint as sufficient
The exact serialized-cause change is coordinated with Termal::Fable2 before coding and is covered by host-facing contract tests

The same core cause selects structured service recovery and word guidance; no cause claims to distinguish a declaration awaiting a future report from one that will never be reported solely from current absence

completion.summary: Delivered typed source recovery causes and one shared safe remedy across service, words, show and raw details. Exact reviewed 32-path tree committed/pushed/installed; full gate passed, independent Codex+Claude reviews have no Medium+, acceptance4/4pass, three live stores ready.
